# TODO: currently disabled

name: "Hotfix - Publish & Deploy"

permissions: {}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ignore_appservice:
        description: "Skip the appservice component"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      ignore_function_api:
        description: "Skip the function-api component"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      ignore_function_integration:
        description: "Skip the function-integration component"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      deploy_dev:
        description: "Deploy to the dev environment"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      deploy_uat:
        description: "Deploy to the uat environment"
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: version-promote
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  scope:
    name: Resolve components
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      components: ${{ steps.select.outputs.components }}
      matrix: ${{ steps.select.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Guard - hotfix runs only from a maintenance branch
        shell: bash
        env:
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "${REF_NAME}" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\.x$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::hotfix workflow must run from a maintenance branch (e.g. 1.4.x). Got: ${REF_NAME}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Build excluded component list
        id: excluded
        shell: bash
        env:
          IGNORE_APPSERVICE: ${{ inputs.ignore_appservice }}
          IGNORE_FUNCTION_API: ${{ inputs.ignore_function_api }}
          IGNORE_FUNCTION_INTEGRATION: ${{ inputs.ignore_function_integration }}
        run: |
          excluded=()
          [ "${IGNORE_APPSERVICE}" = "true" ] && excluded+=("appservice")
          [ "${IGNORE_FUNCTION_API}" = "true" ] && excluded+=("function-api")
          [ "${IGNORE_FUNCTION_INTEGRATION}" = "true" ] && excluded+=("function-integration")
          json="$(printf '%s\n' "${excluded[@]}" | jq -R . | jq -cs 'map(select(length > 0))')"
          echo "json=${json}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Select components
        id: select
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-components
        with:
          excluded-components: ${{ steps.excluded.outputs.json }}

  version:
    name: Compute version
    needs: scope
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      new_tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Compute version
        id: version
        uses: ./.github/actions/compute-version
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.component }}
    needs: [scope, version]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      packages: write
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.scope.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Prepare image coordinates
        id: cfg
        shell: bash
        env:
          SUFFIX: ${{ matrix.suffix }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          NEW_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.new_tag }}
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ needs.version.outputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          repo="$(echo "ghcr.io/${REPOSITORY}${SUFFIX}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          echo "sha_image=${repo}:sha-${COMMIT_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "release_image=${repo}:${NEW_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Login to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@650006c6eb7dba73a995cc03b0b2d7f5ca915bee # v4.2.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@d7f5e7f509e45cec5c76c4d5afdd7de93d0b3df5 # v4.1.0

      - name: Build & push (sha + semantic tag)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@f9f3042f7e2789586610d6e8b85c8f03e5195baf # v7.2.0
        with:
          context: .
          file: ${{ matrix.dockerfile }}
          platforms: linux/amd64
          push: true
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.component }}
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.component }}
          tags: |
            ${{ steps.cfg.outputs.sha_image }}
            ${{ steps.cfg.outputs.release_image }}

  deploy-dev:
    name: '[dev] Deploy'
    if: ${{ !failure() && !cancelled() && inputs.deploy_dev }}
    needs: [scope, version, build]
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_deploy.yml
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      packages: read
      contents: read
    with:
      release_tag: ${{ needs.version.outputs.new_tag }}
      components: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.components }}
      environment: dev
    secrets:
      ARM_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_TENANT_ID }}
      ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      ARM_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_CLIENT_ID }}

  deploy-uat:
    name: '[uat] Deploy'
    if: ${{ !failure() && !cancelled() && inputs.deploy_uat }}
    needs: [scope, version, deploy-dev]
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_deploy.yml
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      packages: read
      contents: read
    with:
      release_tag: ${{ needs.version.outputs.new_tag }}
      components: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.components }}
      environment: uat
    secrets:
      ARM_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_TENANT_ID }}
      ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      ARM_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_CLIENT_ID }}

  deploy-prod:
    name: '[prod] Deploy'
    if: ${{ !failure() && !cancelled() }}
    needs: [scope, version, deploy-uat]
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_deploy.yml
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      packages: read
      contents: read
    with:
      release_tag: ${{ needs.version.outputs.new_tag }}
      components: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.components }}
      environment: prod
    secrets:
      ARM_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_TENANT_ID }}
      ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
      ARM_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.ARM_CLIENT_ID }}
